title: Subquery with GROUP BY filter
prompt: Find hospitals that have more than 2 patients. Return hospital name and patient_count using JOIN + GROUP BY + HAVING.
starterSql:
SELECT hospitals.name, COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM hospitals
JOIN patients ON hospitals.hospital_id = patients.hospital_id
GROUP BY hospitals.name
hints: HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 filters groups after the join.
This pattern replaces many correlated subquery use cases.

validation.solutionSql: SELECT hospitals.name, COUNT(*) AS patient_count FROM hospitals JOIN patients ON hospitals.hospital_id = patients.hospital_id GROUP BY hospitals.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 2
